# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | ** _Republicans are Delivering on the Economy!_**
---
Friends, During the buzz and excitement of primary races, let's take a moment to celebrate our state's Republican leadership. Hoosiers have a lot to be excited about when it comes to our economic future as a state. As we glance at our neighboring states, grappling with the challenges of Democratic governance and the economic struggles that come with Bidenflation, we can't help but feel relief that Indiana's Republican Governor and Republican supermajority in the General Assembly have worked hard to keep Indiana's economy thriving - even when the rest of the nation is struggling. Just look at some of the latest news coming from the Governor's office – an astounding _**$20.68 billion**_ in committed capital investment in just one quarter, crushing records and setting new benchmarks for success. In just the last few weeks, some of the specific announcements include a _**$3.87 billion**_ committed investment from SK hynix for the construction of a state-of-the-art semiconductor facility, a **_$1.4 billion_** committed investment from Toyota for electric vehicle battery assembly, and a whopping _**$11 billion**_ committed investment from Amazon Web Services for a new data center. These achievements are not just numbers; they are new jobs, higher wages, and an economy of the future being built right here in Indiana! That all equates into real investments being made in communities across our state. While our neighboring states struggle to overcome Biden's economy, Republicans in Indiana have led our state to be the #1 ranked state in manufacturing employment and output, #2 in automotive manufacturing, and #3 in cost of living. Low costs and high wages are spreading through all 92 counties. As you prepare to vote in the primary early or on May 7th, remember the economic success that Republican leadership has provided our state. We are better positioned to succeed in the economy of the future than we have ever been, thanks to Republican leadership. Let's keep that momentum going in to November! Thank you for your continued support and for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# _🌟 Sen. Cyndi Carrasco and Rep. Jake Teshka Named Emerging Leaders by GOPAC!_
---
---
GOPAC, a Republican state and local political training organization, tapped 29 legislators nationally for its 2024 class of Emerging Leaders. Sen. Cyndi Carrasco and Rep. Jake Teshka were both selected as 2 of the 29 legislators because of their demonstrated promise in positively impacting our state and rising within the Republican ranks. The Republican Party in Indiana breeds Hoosier leaders, as demonstrated by the selection of 2 legislators in a class of just 29 nationwide. Sen. Carrasco and Rep. Teshka will be part of a yearlong initiative to educate the next generation of Republican legislators. The program is designed to equip legislators with information to help them legislate more effectively and ultimately achieve leadership roles within their state or run for higher office. To read more about the 2024 class and GOPAC click [HERE](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/65dade8b837f798e3947229f28c3afba/a556245becc0bca0c3d6b838967d376c/40313). We at the Indiana Republican party would like to say congratulations to both Sen. Cyndi Carrasco and Rep. Jake Teshka for being selected and wish them success. These legislators have shown that they have what it takes to be leaders of the next generation of Hoosier Republicans.
---

# 📚 Transforming K-12 Education in Indiana 🎓
---
Given that education commands such a significant portion of the state budget (more than half!), we want to ensure we highlight the important work being done by Republican leaders to enhance the Hoosier student journey from Pre-K to graduation. The Indiana Department of Education (IDOE) and its leader, Secretary of Education Dr. Katie Jenner has taken transformative steps to elevate Hoosier education. Appointed by Governor Holcomb in 2021, Dr. Jenner has proven to be an exceptional partner. During her tenure, the IIDOE has proactively taken steps to...
* Improve science of reading and child literacy.
* Rethink high school education to create more opportunities.
* Prepare students for employment, enrollment, or enlistment.
* Expand options and opportunities through school choice.
* Address teacher shortages in high need areas.
* Invest in our students' futures through historic levels of funding.

Under Republican leadership, IDOE has championed efforts to enhance flexibility in diploma requirements without compromising rigor, expand opportunities for high-quality work-based learning, and improve access to valuable credentials before high school graduation. We at the Indiana Republican Party applaud the dedication of Republican leadership and Dr. Jenner to improve Hoosier education. Below you will find detailed information on the ongoing efforts of the IDOE in this regard. Indiana’s educational outlook is strong under Republican leadership!

name: Dr. Marilyn Harper
subject: Reaching out on my son’s behalf
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
I may be biased, but I know Hill will make us all proud.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1194%2E62735%2EgstRh7)
Hello there, Peter. In case we haven’t met yet, I’m Marilyn Harper — Hill’s mom. I can’t just go talking about my son without sharing a picture, so here’s one of my favorites with my grandson Pierce, too ♥️
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1332?t=2&akid=1194%2E62735%2EgstRh7)
**[DONATE TO HILL HARPER FOR SENATE](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1332?t=3&akid=1194%2E62735%2EgstRh7)**
**You probably know that Hill played a doctor on TV, but what you might not know is that Hill himself comes from a family of doctors!** My husband Harry and I both enjoyed long careers in the medical field — he as a psychiatrist, and me as one of the first Black practicing anesthesiologists in the country.
I have no doubt that growing up in our house inspired Hill’s role as “Dr. Hawkes” in _CSI_ and “Dr. Andrews” in _The Good Doctor_ , but I know his passion for equality and healthcare justice was inspired by my own father, Dr. Harold Hill. You see, he was also a pharmacist, one who built his business under Jim Crow. At the time, Black folks weren’t welcome at Rexall or Walgreens, so they went to my father’s pharmacy instead, where young Hill spent the summertime eating popsicles and reading comic books.
Some customers who were in need would barter, trading a sack of potatoes or chickens for prescriptions. Some customers had neither money nor something to trade. But even when they couldn’t pay up, my father provided the prescribed medicine and recorded the transaction in his ledger — something that I know sank into Hill as he sat there, drinking a lemon-lime rickey and reading his books.
**Like his grandfather before him, Hill fiercely believes that no one should go bankrupt because they can’t afford life-saving medical care or medications.** Whether it stems from his own experience battling cancer as an adult or watching my father put people before profits as a child — or both — I’m proud to see Hill fighting for the values Harry and I worked so hard to instill in him.
Peter, that’s how I know Hill will make you proud, too. I never thought my son would run for office, but here we are — and he needs our help! **[It would mean the world to both of us if you would chip in to help Hill win this race for Michigan’s future. Any amount makes a difference, and I know Hill and his team will be so grateful to have your support.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1332?t=4&akid=1194%2E62735%2EgstRh7)**

Thank you so much!
\- Dr. Marilyn Harper

subject: I’ll keep this email short
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I know you probably have better things to do than read these emails, so I’ll keep this one short.
Hey Derek,
I know you probably have better things to do than read these emails, so I’ll keep this one short.
My team tells me that our grassroots fundraising has **fallen off a cliff** today. I get it—it’s almost the weekend, but this means _bad news_.
**[Can split a donation between my campaign and John Fetterman to help us turn things around and reach our end-of-month fundraising goal? I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t important, and I’ll never take your donations for granted.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240426?refcode=em2024046-8947&refcode2=8947_434096_7xlIiw&akid=8947%2E434096%2E7xlIiw)**

I mean it: Your donations keep me focused on meeting with Montanans from every corner of the state and fighting for rural America in the Senate. Thank you.
—Jon Tester

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20240426-8947-footer&t=1&refcode2=8947_434096_7xlIiw&akid=8947%2E434096%2E7xlIiw)**

name: Mariela Roca
subject: 🏁 Final Republican Push 🇺🇸
body:
| | | | | |
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=640391e5ff&e=0a12281e0e)
# Your support today is crucial. 🚨
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2ffdf9b1a8&e=0a12281e0e)
With only 17 days remaining until the pivotal May 14th Maryland primary, your support is absolutely crucial now more than ever. Our campaign is surging forward, engaging voters throughout the district through various channels.
This week alone, we've reached out to 15,000 households with a targeted mailer, 3,000 additional households with 3,000 postcards mailed, placed commercials in Warehouse Cinemas in Frederick and Hagerstown, and broadcasted radio ads across five stations in Western Maryland.
But we're not stopping there—every day until May 14th, I'm actively pursuing opportunities to speak directly to voters on as many radio stations as possible. You can catch a recent candidate statement I made with Montgomery County Media (MCM), which they are currently airing on their networks. 🎥
We're leaving no stone unturned in our quest to secure the Republican nomination on May 14th, and your support is what will propel us to victory.
Click the link below to watch the video! ⬇️
[CLICK HERE TO VIEW VIDEO](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0440910b75&e=0a12281e0e)
# GOTV Efforts & Fundraising
Voting has already begun for the Maryland Primary. Absentee ballots started being mailed by the state of Maryland at the beginning of April. I am proud to say that out of the 16,500 Republican Absentee Voters in MD-06, we have reached almost 90% of these voters via text messages, mailers, and postcards. This is important because, during our 2022 race, we did not have the resources then to reach absentee voters. I am confident that these numbers will show in our favor on May 14th!
The next critical round of voters we need to reach is for Early Voting (May 2nd-9th) & Day of Voting (May 14th). Out of the remaining Republican non-Absentee voters that voted in the 2022 primary (around 44,000 voters) we have also reached about 90% of these voters via door-knocking, mailers, postcards, & text messages. These numbers don’t even include the Facebook Ads, Digital Advertising, Radio, & Movie Theater voters we are reaching. So imagine how much higher our reach actually is!
The purpose of outlining the above numbers is because I want you all to know EXACTLY where your support and contributions have been and are going to be.
Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. Here is what our campaign needs help within the next 17 days to get over the finish line:
1. **Postcard Mailing:** $1,800 (Last 3,000 postcards being mailed out)
2. **Texting:** $3,000 (Last two texts, one on May 1st before early voting starts & one on May 13th the ay before Election Day)
3. **Digital Advertising:** $3,700 (For dates April 29-May 14th)

I know that many of you have already helped our campaign out so much, and many of you have not been able to contribute monetarily due the the economically challenging times we are all facing. I truly believe the future of our district and country is at stake, and I KNOW we can win this nomination with your help through this last push. I have skin in the game as I have also contributed some of my personal funds for this effort. And I really hate to ask you for monetary help, but I need your help now more than ever.
Please consider donating today and helping us fundraise the $8,500 mentioned above by Monday, April 29th to help us get through the primary election on May 14th here in Maryland.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution TODAY:
[**https://secure.winred.com/roca-for-congress/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b95b3b1843&e=0a12281e0e)
The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives. 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6227d56de8&e=0a12281e0e)
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=de24f8625e&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d91d7424b4&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=eb594a86d4&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=c2c18c58bd&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=20fd6ad164&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=84bca2372f&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=d24e913359&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=58db7976c8&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=7eb2a6a3d5&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f7eb002f2a&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=60d5fae05d&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=daae0b1205&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=efc9d53854&e=0a12281e0e)
|

Fellow Conservative,

This may be one of our best chances to expand the Republican majority in Congress.

\*\*Today, I am proud to ask for your support for Kevin Lincoln in California’s 9th Congressional District\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5927995.2548.1.5d48443060c7930dbbc4a47e159c378d ) – _a pivotal battleground for conservatives in 2024. _

Kevin has never been one to back away from a challenge.

\*\*A distinguished Marine Corps veteran\*\* , Kevin proudly served on Marine One in the aftermath of 9/11, protecting our nation’s highest office. Currently, he serves as \*\*a Republican mayor\*\* in one of California’s largest Democrat-leaning cities.

-> \*\*_CHIP IN TO SUPPORT KEVIN LINCOLN »_\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5927995.2550.1.f7750a71273b2303c5de8e88dce026fd )<-

I believe Kevin is the kind of leader and fighter we need on our team in the House. \*\*Will you support his campaign with a contribution of $25 or any amount you can spare?\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5927995.2551.1.91f09297eb8b7c0039d649e4a4c45b15 )

CA-9 presents a prime opportunity for us to turn a blue seat RED and strengthen our House majority. It’s clear – Kevin Lincoln is the conservative we need to make that happen.

But we know it will be a tough fight against a well-funded Democrat incumbent. \*\*That’s why we need every bit of support from patriots like you, fellow conservative.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=5927995.2552.1.258965b3c78cd69c6fcd25fa2c13583c )

Thank you for standing strong with us.

_ \*\*Mike Johnson\*\* _

Speaker of the House

->

->\*\*Meet Kevin Lincoln

\*\*<-

My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

name: Bill Posey Campaign
subject: Bill Posey Announces Retirement, Endorses Mike Haridopolos
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Bill Posey
body:
| | |
---
| | Friends, It has been the greatest honor of Katie’s and my life to represent you in Congress. And, polls suggest that because of YOUR support, I could remain in the job forever, and we were looking forward to another spirited campaign for a final term in office. However, earlier this week circumstances beyond my control now require me to suspend my re-election campaign. I will continue to devote all possible resources to continue representing you through the end of my current term, helping President Donald Trump return to the oval office, and supporting former Florida Senate President Mike Haridopolos, in whom I have the greatest trust and confidence, to take up my battles against the swamp and replace me as your Congressman. There are many people qualified to replace me. Unfortunately, until Mike Haridopolos committed to run, the other declared candidates were not among them.For many years, Mike has served as my Congressional Finance Committee Chairman, while I have mentored him to replace me. Mike was, and remains, my first choice to represent you, me, and our district in congress. Without going into a lot of personal details, stars aligned during the past week and Mike decided he was ready for Congress. I enthusiastically endorse him and will do everything I can to help him get elected. Mike’s conservative values and work ethic are superior and unlike others who have filed to run against me, Mike has never lied to me or tried to undermine efforts to represent our district. Mike knows our district and has stayed involved at local, state, and federal levels. He is clearly the kind of representative we need in Congress, and I have no doubt he will excel in the job.May God bless you, and may God continue to bless the United States of America!
---

| | | **Strengthen Our Resilience on National Richter Scale Day**
---

Dear Peter,
Today, on National Richter Scale Day, we recognize the essential tools that help us understand and prepare for earthquakes—a reality we live with in Washington's 8th congressional district. This day reminds us of the importance of preparedness and the continuous need for advancements in our local disaster response strategies.

I remember the 2001 quake that shook Washington. We need to be prepared for the next big one and Congress needs to take steps to help the west coast prepare for that. In Congress I will work with my colleagues to ensure that we have the resources we need to be ready to respond to the next big quake.

subject: Racking up miles on my Chevy
body:
I wanted to take a minute to share a couple of photos to show you what the team and I have been up to.
#
I’ve been traveling up and down Delaware a ton lately, racking up miles on my Chevy and building the broad statewide coalition we need to win. I’ve always said that campaigns are conversations, and there’s nothing I love more than engaging with neighbors about how we can deliver for Delaware in Congress.
**I wanted to take a minute to share a couple of photos to show you what the team and I have been up to:**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240426?refcode=em20240426-1-177&amp;amount=5&refcode2=177_21716_XnSmnA&akid=177%2E21716%2EXnSmnA)
From affordable health care and housing to reproductive rights and environmental sustainability, folks were fired up and ready for leaders in DC who have a proven ability to roll up their sleeves, bring people together, and deliver real results for our neighbors.
But while there’s nothing I love more than getting out there and talking to Delawareans,**it takes resources to run a campaign — and being on the road means I have even less time to make fundraising calls.**
That’s where I’m hoping you can help! I need to stay on the road talking to as many folks as possible, but we also need to raise the funds necessary to keep this campaign going.
[**So, can you pitch in $5 today to keep me on the campaign trail as much as possible? Your support means so much to me and the team!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240426?refcode=em20240426-1-177&amount=5&refcode2=177_21716_XnSmnA&akid=177%2E21716%2EXnSmnA)

Team —
On January 6, 2021, the very existence of our democracy was threatened and, for the first time in American history, the peaceful transition of power was interrupted.
The insurrectionists have not been defeated. The attempted coup on that day may have failed, but its architects have been emboldened and they are, in fact, planning the next one.
Today, we’re going to start fighting back. The Democracy Defense Fund is an organization committed to saving our country from the authoritarian traitors who seek to destroy it — but we need your help.
Will you join our pro-democracy movement by splitting a donation between the Democracy Defense Fund and Seth Moulton? Any amount helps in our fight to save democracy. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-ddf]
You know my uncle. He started the “Big Lie” and he continues to traffic in the right-wing extremism that puts our country at risk.
We must stop him and his loyal cronies and those, at all levels of government, who continue to undermine our democracy. That’s why I founded the Democracy Defense Fund — and it’s why Seth Moulton and I are asking for your help now.
We need resources to support organizations and people who are committed to protecting the right to vote and preserving our Constitution, just like Seth Moulton.

We think it should go without saying, but _everyone_ deserves safe, affordable, and sustainable housing, folks.
On any given day, 650,000 people across the country have nowhere to call home. And the devastating impact of the climate crisis definitely isn’t helping.
The Green New Deal for Public Housing Act would impact millions of people, provide thousands of jobs, and _drastically_ reduce the nation’s annual carbon emissions. Through this monumental initiative, we could tackle climate change _and_ the housing crisis at the same time.
That sounds like a win to us.
This isn’t a partisan issue: It’s a human decency issue. More jobs and less poverty — that’s how we move this country forward.
[By investing in green infrastructure, we benefit our communities AND our planet, but we can’t do this alone. No one person can win a race for U.S. Senate by themselves.

But there are a lot of things I can’t do on my own – which is why we’re building a grassroots team of volunteers who are knocking doors, making calls, and talking to voters as early as possible.

Here is a photo from our first “Snow Boots on the Ground” of 2024 from last month. We’ve done similar events rain, snow, or shine in every one of my campaigns since 2018 because I believe a ground game — knocking doors, making calls, sending texts, and registering voters — is critical to win in our very swingy swing state. The goal is to train up volunteers to make sure they have what they need to talk to voters early.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/83788751/469518113/-2001351941?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240426_1_2&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjc1YzE0NjkzLTAwMDQtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=-z_YsGPlmXOyemc1uFFXST65OgBhy6lUJ4YVEsPaM9k=)
But there’s another thing I can’t do myself, and that’s fund a winning campaign with personal resources. While some of our opponents can write themselves big checks, our campaign is relying on a whole lot of people chipping in a little at a time.

If we're going to keep this Senate seat blue, and if we're going to make sure Joe Biden wins Michigan (and the White House), it will take all of us.

Our average online donation is around $40.

body:
My friend Harry Dunn is running for Congress in Maryland’s Third District,
and we’re working to support him. I hope you’ll read the message below
from him and consider splitting a donation between Harry’s campaign and my
own.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=apr2024_abs_em_dunn.NiWJPM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240426_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1003&akid=6317%2E5257348%2EXAUs-z ]Harry Dunn

Hey Derek,
it's Harry Dunn here, one of the Capitol police officers who defended the
U.S. Capitol against MAGA insurrectionists just three years ago and
testified in front of the January 6th Committee.

I'm hoping to make my return to DC – but not as a Capitol police officer.
I'm officially running to serve Maryland's 3rd Congressional District in
the U.S. House.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=apr2024_abs_em_dunn.NiWJPM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240426_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6317%2E5257348%2EXAUs-z ]I’m counting on your support to get there. Can you rush a split
donation of $10 or more between Adam Schiff and me ahead of our important
monthly fundraising deadline?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=apr2024_abs_em_dunn.NiWJPM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240426_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=6317%2E5257348%2EXAUs-z ]CHIP IN $10 >>

Here's the thing,
Derek: I never thought I would
run for office. Growing up, I wanted to be just like my dad, who was an
athlete and a U.S. Air Force Veteran. I played football and earned an
athletic scholarship that sent me to college. (I was pretty good, but
being 6-foot-7 sure didn’t hurt!)

But wearing a football uniform taught me something special: it gave me
purpose and made me feel a part of something bigger than myself.

So when I put on my Capitol police uniform for the first time over 15
years ago to protect our nation’s Capitol, it felt right.

But I never thought I’d see the day that our democracy would be attacked
by Donald Trump and an army of insurrectionists that HE directed to the
Capitol.

I couldn't have been any closer to the chaos of January 6. I put my life
on the line during the violence and destruction that Trump encouraged. So
trust and believe when I tell you: we cannot allow our democracy to be in
the hands of these MAGA extremists.

I fought for our democracy and our Capitol once as Officer Dunn, and I'll
do it again as Congressman Dunn.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1015?c0=apr2024_abs_em_dunn.NiWJPM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240426_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=6317%2E5257348%2EXAUs-z ]Please, can you chip in a split donation between Adam Schiff and me of
$10 or $25 today? I seriously appreciate any help you can give today >>

Harry Dunn

Team – before you sign off for the weekend:
I’ve said this before and I know I’m going to keep saying it throughout my career – I’m not a huge fan of asking people for money. There are so many causes, organizations, and great candidates out there, and look – I’m self-aware enough to know that you just can’t give money every single time you get an email asking you to!
But after two successful campaigns, I’ve learned a lot about why we need to make these asks. Winning an election, no matter how you slice it, takes a lot of resources.
And the things we do to win elections – knocking on doors, running ads online and on TV, building up websites, making phone calls, talking to people out in the community – are meaningful. Bringing people into the electoral process – empowering folks to feel connected to their leaders, to know that they have a real stake in their leaders and our government... it’s a big deal.
So before this email gets too long and you hit that delete button – to help fund that critical voter outreach, will you pitch in $5, $10, or whatever you can to my re-election campaign? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Like they do every month, my team is spending the last few days of April making sure we’re on track for our big-picture fundraising needs between now and November – and without your support, the road to a successful Election Day is a lot longer.
So if you can, I’m asking you to be a part of this work.
Please, chip in any amount before the end of April, and help build up a strong and inclusive re-election campaign that will bring new voters into the process. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you so much for anything you can give. I really appreciate it.
-Sara

clean_body: [] Team – before you sign off for the weekend: I’ve said this before and I know I’m going to keep saying it throughout my career – I’m not a huge fan of asking people for money. There are so many causes, organizations, and great candidates out there, and look – I’m self-aware enough to know that you just can’t give money every single time you get an email asking you to! But after two successful campaigns, I’ve learned a lot about why we need to make these asks. Winning an election, no matter how you slice it, takes a lot of resources. And the things we do to win elections – knocking on doors, running ads online and on TV, building up websites, making phone calls, talking to people out in the community – are meaningful. Bringing people into the electoral process – empowering folks to feel connected to their leaders, to know that they have a real stake in their leaders and our government... it’s a big deal. So before this email gets too long and you hit that delete button – to help fund that critical voter outreach, will you pitch in $5, $10, or whatever you can to my re-election campaign? [] Like they do every month, my team is spending the last few days of April making sure we’re on track for our big-picture fundraising needs between now and November – and without your support, the road to a successful Election Day is a lot longer. So if you can, I’m asking you to be a part of this work. Please, chip in any amount before the end of April, and help build up a strong and inclusive re-election campaign that will bring new voters into the process. [] Thank you so much for anything you can give. I really appreciate it. -Sara [] Congresswoman Sara Jacobs California’s 51st District CONTRIBUTE [] If you can’t give much right now, I want you to know that even $1 or $5 makes a difference. [] And if you can’t give at all, I understand. Friend,
The United States just sent a strong message to the rest of the world: we stand with democracy and the Ukrainian people.
Putin’s lawless invasion of Ukraine in 2022 disrupted the international order in Europe that had existed since World War II. He is responsible for the death of thousands of Ukrainians, the destruction of cities, and jeopardizing global energy and food supplies.
For two years, the Ukrainian people have beat all expectations and held off the Russian armies. But they cannot do it alone.
I’ve done everything possible to raise awareness about this fight and provide humanitarian, economic, and security assistance for Ukraine. Ukraine has been running out of bullets — as isolationists in the Republican Party put up obstacle after obstacle.
After months of hard work, Congress finally passed funding for Ukraine, and President Biden signed it into law.
This is a great moment in American history and a great moment for democracy. This isn’t over, but with our support, Ukraine can continue its fight to defeat Putin.

Friend,

After an overwhelmingly bipartisan vote, the U.S. Senate has _passed_ a foreign aid bill that will send urgent assistance to Ukraine.
The very next day, the White House announced that urgently needed air defense systems and artillery rounds – to the tune of $1 billion – would reach Ukrainian battlefields within days, providing the Ukrainian people and President Zelensky the support they have desperately needed at this life-or-death moment.

Even beyond sending aid to Ukraine, this spending package provides an essential provision to seize the assets of Vladimir Putin’s partners in conflict and use those assets to rebuild Ukraine. So we are both supporting our democratic ally and holding the cruel enablers of Russia’s murderous invasion accountable.

With this aid package, the United States has reminded the dictators of the world – Vladimir Putin specifically – that we will not retreat in the face of wanton aggression. So long as our allies are in crisis on the world stage, I will push to support them. Thank you for your attention to, and support of, this critical fight for democracy.
Dick

| Climate change is one of the _biggest_ challenges facing our country, and it’s our responsibility to leave behind a healthy and thriving planet for future generations to come.

As Baltimore County Executive, Johnny O set a **5-year deadline** to transition county government operations to entirely renewable energy by 2026.

**Johnny worked with local partners to install solar panels at closed landfills, utilizing public lands to achieve our climate goals, saving millions of dollars and generating renewable energy to power our communities and neighborhoods.**

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Jon Tester is running for re-election to the Senate in 2024, and we’re working to support him. I hope you’ll read the message below from him and [**consider splitting a donation between Jon's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-tester.fTV-ub&refcode=em240426-1-30&t=1&akid=5748%2E6688874%2EwYCVJc)

Hi folks.
Here’s a photo of my grandparents, Arnfred and Christine, on their wedding day in 1905. That was a couple years before they picked out a flat piece of grassland just outside Big Sandy to homestead.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-tester.fTV-ub&refcode=em240426-1-30&t=2&akid=5748%2E6688874%2EwYCVJc)
That patch of loamy, alkaline clay-soil is the same one where I grew up; where Sharla and I raised our kids, and where we still farm the land to this day.
Things weren’t easy for Fred and Christine. They suffered devastating windstorms, bitter cold, fires, poisonous snakes—pretty much everything but locusts. They had a couple hundred acres to their name, a newly-built barn, a windmill, their healthy son and daughters (including Helen, my mom), strong muscles, and the powerful work ethic that built rural America.
I first ran for office to make sure our government was serving hardworking Americans like my grandparents. Folks like our teachers, farmers, and construction workers deserve a government that fights for them.
But the special interests trying to unseat me don’t care about that. Dark money groups are spending millions of dollars to misinform voters and replace me with a mouthpiece for their own agenda. They’ll do whatever it takes to elect their handpicked candidate because they don’t care about protecting our way of life—they’re just in it for power and influence.

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: I was in the hospital for three months
disclaimer_text: Paid for by No Dem Left Behind PAC
body:
Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care
---
| | | | | | [ ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ndlb-senator-baldwin?refcode=health)
---
| | | | | |
---
| | | | Hi there, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." Look, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican mega-donors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. The people of Wisconsin did not send me to Washington to take people’s health care away, which is why I fought against Republican repeal efforts and why I will never back down. But I can’t defend the hard-fought progress we’ve made without your help, right now. clean_body: Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there, it’s Tammy Baldwin. I wanted to take this opportunity to tell you a little more about myself, why I ran for the U.S. Senate, and why our campaign in Wisconsin is so important. When I was a child, I was diagnosed with a serious illness and spent three months in the hospital. When I got better, my grandparents, who raised me, began looking for an insurance policy that would cover me in the future. But they couldn’t find such a policy because of my previous illness. Not from any insurer. Not at any price. They had to pay for my health care out of pocket — and they had to make enormous sacrifices to do so — all because I was a child labeled with those words: "pre-existing condition." Look, I got into public service because I saw my grandparents stay up late at night, worried sick that I would fall ill again and that they wouldn't be able to afford my care. No one should ever have to go through that. Like 133 million Americans, I know what it's like to have the label "pre-existing condition" attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. Today, insurance companies can no longer discriminate against someone based on their pre-existing condition. I championed health reform and fought to allow young people to stay on their parent’s insurance plan up to age 26. These policy changes have led to millions more Americans getting the health insurance they need. So, you can imagine my frustration whenever Republicans attack our health care or threaten protections for folks with pre-existing conditions — people like me. The GOP has spent years playing politics with people’s lives. And if Mitch McConnell and his Republican mega-donors flip my seat in Wisconsin and take hold of the Senate majority next election, countless Americans could find themselves in a place where insurance companies, once again, write all the rules. | **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. Friends,

One of the things we’ve heard most often on the campaign trail is how people just feel totally cut off from what’s going on in Washington. That no matter what we do here, Congress is just going to do their own thing – which has been a whole lot of “nothing.” This is a Do-Nothing Congress, always focused on fighting and not fixing anything.

Shouldn’t our representatives in Congress actually do their jobs? That seems like something we can all get behind.

We’re looking at you, Nick.

When Nick LaLota was elected, he said he’d move to the district. But no. He’s nowhere to be found. It’s just another broken MAGA promise.

John Avlon’s running to change that. Here in Suffolk County, your word is your bond. When John’s promising to get to work, he means it. The stakes are too high for all of us.

If you want a member of Congress who actually shares your values – we need your help. Pitch in today and help us build a coalition to win this fight >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-donate-emq2?]

Think about your job. If you treated it like a no-show gig, did literally nothing but take credit for other people’s accomplishments, and broke the biggest promise you made when you got hired?

Yeah, you’d be out like yesterday’s trash. It’s a firing offense.

Before we go - we’ve got a question for No-Show Nick: When you can’t even vote for yourself, why should anyone else?

Thought so.

-Team Avlon

With our end-of-month deadline fast approaching, we’re reaching out to ask ****[if you could match this amount.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83797546/469536987/179801787?refcode=odp_em_240426_1&amount=23.28&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOGNkNjNkMy0wZTA0LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cKEGoJyClFU_J9MeWqHFGz08wlvKgWYWe8EUj4jbcjI=)**** Republican spending is pouring into Ohio, and much of it is funded by just a few dark money donors and mega-millionaires. Friend,

Earlier this month, Volkswagen workers in Tennessee did something that hadn’t been done since the 1940s — they voted to unionize. It was the first auto plant in the South to organize a union in 80 years. It’s a massive victory for UAW and workers everywhere. It shows that worker power is growing nationwide.

Republicans, like Tennessee Governor Bill Lee, aren’t happy about it. The GOP wants to help big corporations hoard record profits, not give workers a fair shake. But as UAW President Shawn Fain says: “Record profits mean record contracts.”

Unions play a critical role in strengthening the middle class. On average, unionized workers earn 10 to 15 percent more than nonunionized workers.

Add your name to stand with workers and support union organizing across the country. Worker power is the way to raise wages, improve benefits, and ensure safe working conditions! body:
I’m writing to you because Kari Lake was recently endorsed by Josh Hawley, the Senator from Missouri.
#

Peter, this is retired Capitol Police Staff Sergeant and U.S. Army Veteran Aquilino Gonell.
I’m writing to you because Kari Lake was recently endorsed by Josh Hawley, the Senator from Missouri.
Yes, this Josh Hawley:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-apr24.p6MMmT&refcode=em240426-2-160&t=1&akid=2253%2E734936%2EXcjHE1)
The same guy who riled up Trump’s mob before they stormed the Capitol, and the same guy who ran for his life while my fellow officers and I risked our lives to protect everyone, including Hawley.
We stood our ground and fought for our lives against the mob. They sided against the Constitution yet they claimed to support the rule of law and the police.
This is the type of person Kari Lake wants in her corner.
As for me, I’m proud to be in Ruben’s corner.
While we fought the insurrectionists that day, Ruben supported his colleagues on the House floor. He was ready to fight, too.
He’s going to fight every day to defeat Kari Lake and make sure there is no home for insurrectionists in the Senate.
That’s more than enough for me. If you’re with Ruben and can’t wait to put an end to Kari Lake’s political ambitions, please:

Our kids are being shot at their desks. And what do Tennessee Republicans want to do about it? Put _more_ guns in our schools. _This is the kind of BS legislation you get when elected officials are yes-men to the gun lobby instead of representatives for the people they serve._ **_[It’s happening in state legislatures across this country and in Washington, D.C. Far-right extremists like my opponent Marsha Blackburn care more about raking in their campaign dollars than protecting our people. Your grassroots donation today will help me defeat her and get to work to fight for real gun violence prevention.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83801502/469547915/209297649?refcode=ea.beac0453-1804-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.beac0453-1804-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZWFjMDQ1My0xODA0LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-Nmx-0994FElirhrsQ9oAAcos-Ur7asnkwDTTcYxhX4=)_** In 2023, the U.S. averaged nearly one school shooting incident per day. One of those shootings was right here in Nashville. On March 27, 2023, gun violence tore through Covenant School and devastated our community. Survivors and families _begged_ their elected leaders for change. _GOP politicians silenced them._ **Now, instead of doing the bare minimum — passing the commonsense reforms that work like background checks and red flag laws — they want to arm our teachers. Make it make sense.** Y’all, I spent decades as a public school educator. I’ve been on campus when a student was shot. I heard kids screaming. **Giving teachers guns solves _nothing_. It only increases the odds that someone is going to get hurt.** Republicans want you to think that they’re (finally) doing something so you’ll look the other way when they take big checks from the gun lobby and vote exactly the way gun manufacturers want. **_[The only way this changes is if we send far-right politicians packing and elect leaders who will actually _do something._ I need your help NOW if I’m going to take on Marsha Blackburn and her gun-lobby donors. clean_body: Protect our students. Pass commonsense reform. | Our kids are being shot at their desks. And what do Tennessee Republicans want to do about it? Put more guns in our schools. This is the kind of BS legislation you get when elected officials are yes-men to the gun lobby instead of representatives for the people they serve. = In 2023, the U.S. averaged nearly one school shooting incident per day. One of those shootings was right here in Nashville. On March 27, 2023, gun violence tore through Covenant School and devastated our community. Survivors and families begged their elected leaders for change. GOP politicians silenced them. Now, instead of doing the bare minimum — passing the commonsense reforms that work like background checks and red flag laws — they want to arm our teachers. Make it make sense. Y’all, I spent decades as a public school educator. I’ve been on campus when a student was shot. I heard kids screaming. Giving teachers guns solves nothing. It only increases the odds that someone is going to get hurt. | | April 26, 2024

Dear Friend,

This week, I was proud and honored to receive the endorsement of former California Secretary of State Bill Jones in my race for Congress against Jim Costa.

In his endorsement, Jones wrote: "Michael's military background and knowledge of national security are invaluable credentials when a majority of the people are concerned about safety at an international and local level."

The Honorable Bill Jones served in the State Assembly with Jim Costa in the late 1980s and early 1990s. He was elected California Secretary of State in 1994, serving during Governor Pete Wilson's second term. He also represented Fresno County in the State Assembly and was Assembly Minority Leader.

While the world is growing more dangerous by the day, there are also many needs here at home: providing adequate water supplies and affordable energy, preserving farmland, stopping human and fentanyl trafficking, and lowering taxes. Congressman Jim Costa has failed to meet these critical needs. We need new leadership to represent us in Congress.

That's why I need your support. On $5 Friday, consider committing to a recurring weekly gift of $5 (less than a gallon of gas, unfortunately). You can also give in other amounts, but our campaign is relying on your support to sustain our outreach efforts, help supply our dozens of volunteers, and win this election in November.

Please consider a $5 weekly gift or anything you can do by clicking the secure donate button.

Michael and his wife Anne, who comes from a local multigenerational valley farming family, live in Fresno County where their two children attend local public school and where Michael owns and operates his aviation business. _

_Maher is a United States Navy veteran, and served abroad the USS Salt Lake City, a Los Angeles Class Fast Attack Submarine. Following the Navy, Michael graduated from Fresno Pacific University and then was accepted and graduated from FBI Academy in Quantico, Virginia. name: Al Franken
subject: screaming and crying, and poop
disclaimer_text: paid for and provided in kind by End Citizens United Nonfederal, P
body:
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=21322%2E4449941%2EsCcfW9)
---
Running for office is tough. You have to ask a bunch of people for money (like this), and then the other side gets together and says lots of mean things about you.

Having a baby is tough, too. There’s lots of screaming and crying, poop gets everywhere, and you don’t get any sleep. Now that I think about it, it’s a lot like running for office...

Team, I’m writing because my friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is doing BOTH. First, I laughed and told him he was crazy. When I realized he wasn’t joking, I said I’d help!

[**Josh is running for Congress in NY-19, and his race could decide the House majority. Will you join me and split a contribution between Josh Riley to help him win one of the most important races in the country and Fight for Reform so they can elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42499?t=7&akid=21322%2E4449941%2EsCcfW9)

Josh is used to doing things the hard way.

He grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood in Endicott, NY. When the local factories closed, Josh saw his community struggle – but he worked to put himself through school and graduated from Harvard Law.

In the Senate, Josh and I brought Republicans and Democrats together to actually get stuff done (yes, it really is possible)! The bills we worked on together expanded rights for survivors of domestic abuse and provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. It wasn’t easy, but Josh got them signed into law.

**Now, Josh is running for Congress without taking any corporate PAC money. He knows it’s not the easy route, but it’s the right thing to do.**

But that means he’s relying on folks like you and me chipping in. And with his time spread thin between the campaign, the new baby and, ya know, still having time to breathe, he’s relying on us now more than ever. [**So if you can, please split a contribution between Fight for Reform and Josh’s campaign today. Josh’s race will be one of the most competitive in the entire country, and he’ll win it with our help.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42499?t=8&akid=21322%2E4449941%2EsCcfW9) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Josh Riley will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42500?t=9&akid=21322%2E4449941%2EsCcfW9)
---

Thanks,

Al

**P.S.** I always add a P.S to these letters to make another ask. [**If you read this far and haven’t donated already, what are you waiting for?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/42499?t=14&akid=21322%2E4449941%2EsCcfW9)

clean_body: We must take back the House to protect vital programs and access to care. | | | | In 2009 I backed the Affordable Care Act (ACA), and now almost one million Washingtonians under the age of sixty-five receive health care through the ACA. These statistics demonstrate that Americans want access to quality, affordable health care. Whether it is lowering the cost of prescription drugs, allowing young people to stay insured through their parents until age 26, or helping under- or uninsured folks get the coverage they need to be able to seek medical care — in the last 15 years, we have seen the benefits of the ACA and know the importance of protecting health care for all of us. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Join my campaign to save democracy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
In order to change the world, we need to recognize what we’re up against.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240426-3806-footer&t=1&akid=3806%2E420207%2E7y7E-K)
Peter,
In order to change the world, we need to recognize what we’re up against.
It’s not just the looming threat of Donald Trump. There are historic levels of wealth inequality. A housing crisis that has reached a fever pitch. The war in Gaza rages on, all while the majority of people support a permanent ceasefire.
The list goes on.
**But amidst it all, one thing is clear—there is hope.**
We’ve taken on the most powerful special interests our country has ever known and we’ve defeated them time and time again—because that is what we do! And we will do it again—**but we need your help.**
We need you to join our movement. We need you to pitch in to help build our grassroots campaign. Your work will not only support our campaign, you will help strengthen our progressive movement nationwide.
I know some of you reading this want to sit this election out right now. You may be frustrated with the status quo–and rightfully so! You’re right to be angry about the relentless attacks on our democracy, our rights, and our humanity. But I believe we can do it, and we must do it.
This is a battle for our democracy. Our campaign must remain a voice of progressive power and a beacon of hope. [**Will you support this movement with a donation of $3 or anything you're able to give to help us reach our April fundraising goal of $8,725 before the clock strikes midnight on Tuesday?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240426.VwVj6b&refcode=em20240426-3806&t=2&akid=3806%2E420207%2E7y7E-K)

The balance of our government at ALL levels depends on the upcoming election and the resources we’ve gathered.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/83803212/469553678/-1702732256?refcode=BLU_EM_SAN_2024-04-26_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODI2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDFmMDJkNS0yMDA0LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FoNywn_0F3r847U9CiO5q6D0cpVjSq6uYZoOM2tuT1c=)

| Peter,

Trump has made it clear that he is willing to do whatever it takes to win, including undermining the results of an election.

_**This poses a serious threat to the fabric and foundation of our Democracy.**_

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=2827%2E552475%2EwXFJDU)
Peter, today’s the last day of our On Our Side Road Trip. Well, Leg One that is.
It’s been a great week. From Luzerne County to Allegheny County, we covered a lot of miles and met with so many of the Pennsylvanians we’re fighting for — workers, children, seniors, veterans, and people with disabilities.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240426-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240426-2&refcode2=2827_552475_wXFJDU&akid=2827%2E552475%2EwXFJDU)
Thank you for following along and staying updated on the race. I’m grateful to have folks like you on our team in the fight ahead.
[**Now, the general election is here, and we need to double down on our efforts. Will you pitch in $5 or more to make sure we have the resources necessary to win in November?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240426-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240426-2&refcode2=2827_552475_wXFJDU&akid=2827%2E552475%2EwXFJDU)
We’re officially up against David McCormick, a Trump-endorsed mega-millionaire who’s trying to buy this seat to benefit himself and his Wall Street friends.
McCormick is wrong for Pennsylvania, but Donald Trump and national Republicans are lining up behind him to flip PA red and take back the Senate. They’ve been flooding Pennsylvania’s airwaves, and it’s only going to get worse.
[**With the Senate majority hinging on PA, I have to ask one more time: Can you make a $5 or more donation to my re-election campaign right now to fight back against GOP attacks and keep this seat, and the Senate, blue?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240426-2?recurring=1&refcode=em20240426-2&refcode2=2827_552475_wXFJDU&akid=2827%2E552475%2EwXFJDU)

Peter,

Border security is national security.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: CEO pay is out of control
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
We’ve got to tax the rich to increase opportunity for all, and it’s time to put more money and power in the hands of working people.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2149%2E4032634%2EesASjA)
---
Have you ever gotten a 26% raise? You’d think that such a hefty bump would come after a pretty impressive year. But from 2022 to 2023 the CEO of Warner Bros. got a compensation increase of over 26% — to nearly $50 million, including bonuses and stock awards — despite a year that was rocky, to say the least. Despite layoffs. Despite box office bombs. Despite a lagging stock price. Meanwhile, Warner Bros. workers had to strike for higher pay. CEO pay is out of control. Millionaires and billionaires are making out like bandits. So it’s safe to say they can — and must — pay their fair share to keep our country running. [**Add your name if you agree: we’ve got to tax the rich to increase opportunity for all, and it’s time to put more money and power in the hands of working people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-taxtherich/?source=EMZ19W_TAX_E_20240426_V1S1&t=8&akid=2149%2E4032634%2EesASjA) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-taxtherich/?source=EMZ19W_TAX_E_20240426_V1S1&t=9&akid=2149%2E4032634%2EesASjA)
---
There are plenty of ways we can get the rich and powerful to pay their fair share.
The IRS can keep up its new crackdown on wealthy tax cheats — a step I pushed for, and which Democrats funded as part of the Inflation Reduction Act.
We can pass President Biden’s plan for a minimum tax on billionaires, because Jeff Bezos shouldn’t pay a lower tax rate than a public school teacher.
We can also enact his proposal to increase my minimum tax on massive corporate profits.
And we can put a two-cent wealth tax on net worths bigger than $50 million, with another penny per dollar for the billionaires.
From paid leave and child care to affordable housing, we can use new tax revenue to build a future for all of our kids.
[**If you think we need to build an economy that works not just for wealthy CEOs but all working people, add your name — and let’s make it happen side by side.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-taxtherich/?source=EMZ19W_TAX_E_20240426_V1S1&t=10&akid=2149%2E4032634%2EesASjA)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
